overview_description.description:
Matik provides an online platform that generates personalized customer presentations in minutes. The platform automatically generates native Google Slide or PowerPoint presentations with customized data inputs.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Matik provides an online platform that generates personalized customer presentations in minutes.

product.name: Matik Platform
product.description: An online platform that automates the creation of personalized, data-driven presentations and reports using live data integration and AI-generated insights.

product.name: Smart Data Sync
product.description: A Chrome extension that embeds live data into Google Slides and Sheets, enabling automated updates of presentations and reports with real-time data.

product.name: Matik Mail
product.description: A service that automates the delivery of personalized, data-driven PDF attachments via email, including branded tables and charts.

product.name: Data Integration and Querying
product.description: A capability to connect to multiple data sources and query data without ingestion, enabling dynamic content generation based on live data.

product.name: AI-Powered Insight Generation
product.description: An AI feature that creates personalized, data-driven insights, executive summaries, and talk tracks within presentations and reports.
